title: Financing Deadlines, Loan Denial and Financing Changes on the Home Purchase Agreement
content:
A Home Purchase Agreement requires the buyer to evidence financing by fixed deadlines after the contract date, gives a financed buyer a cancellation right on a written loan denial, and records any change of financing after signing.

## Financing deliverables

- A financed buyer must complete a full loan application within the collection's loan application days after the contract date.
- A buyer financing with an outside lender must also deliver a written loan approval within the collection's outside-lender approval days.
- A cash buyer must deliver proof of funds within the collection's cash proof of funds days.

A missed item is a buyer default and starts the agreement's buyer default and termination terms with a default notice.

## Loan denial

A buyer whose loan is denied in writing may cancel with refund of the collection's loan-denial refund percent of the refundable deposits. **A cancellation request with basis financing denial is honored only when it is received within the collection's financing contingency days (calendar days) after the contract date.** Counting starts the day after the contract date and the last counted day is included. The dates compared are the contract date on the agreement and the received date on the buyer's cancellation request.

The lot premium deposit is refunded on a financing denial only where the collection marks the lot premium deposit as refundable. A cash buyer has no financing contingency.

*Boundary (hypothetical).* With a 30-day figure and a contract date of 1 March, the counted days run 2 March through 31 March. A financing-denial request received on 31 March is honored; one received on 1 April is not.

## Change of financing after signing

A change of financing type after signing is recorded on the agreement as a financing change. A change to an outside lender or to cash makes the outside-lender or cash extra deposit due within the collection's signing deposit business days of the change, and revokes incentives under the agreement's incentive terms.

## Summary by financing type

| Financing type | Must deliver | Financing contingency |
|---|---|---|
| Calloway Home Mortgage | Full loan application within the loan application days | Yes: a written denial lets the buyer cancel, if requested within the financing contingency days |
| Outside lender | Full loan application within the loan application days and a written loan approval within the outside-lender approval days | Yes: same terms |
| Cash | Proof of funds within the cash proof of funds days | None |
